implementationWarning: These stable IDs and values are design-reference data only. Reconcile with implementation IDs and balance-test values before importing into game code.

characters.title: The Forgeguard

ability.name: Forgeguard
ability.shortEffect: Gain 10 Guard. If the current attack damages Darius, scorch the attacker for 3 damage.

characters.visualSignature: Heavy plated silhouette, horned brow, badger-like digging claws, tortoise shell plates, oversized anvil maul.
characters.cardCopy: A walking bastion who makes every blow costly.

characters.title: The Raven

ability.name: Void Feint
ability.shortEffect: Cancel the current enemy action.

characters.visualSignature: Raven-headed shadow duelist, layered feather mantle, subtle octopus-like flexible tendrils, paired hooked blades.
characters.cardCopy: A deceptive killer who turns an enemy's intent into nothing.

characters.title: The Plaguewright

ability.name: Lingering Infection
ability.shortEffect: Apply 3 poison damage at the end of each of the next four turns.

characters.visualSignature: Hyena-like hunched profile, axolotl gills, leech-like skin folds and a staff bearing diseased relics.
characters.cardCopy: A patient architect of wounds that refuse to close.

characters.title: The Oathbreaker

ability.name: Vengeful Oath
ability.shortEffect: Retaliate for the damage of the enemy's declared attack.

characters.visualSignature: Antlered silhouette with carrion-feather mantle, scorpion-tail accents, and a fractured ceremonial glaive.
characters.cardCopy: Every betrayal is answered in kind.

characters.title: The Oracle

ability.name: Threadseer
ability.shortEffect: Gain two additional rerolls and reveal only the next enemy intent.

characters.visualSignature: Owl-faced seer, moth-wing mantle, a restrained anglerfish lure integrated into a lantern sceptre.
characters.cardCopy: She glimpses the next thread, never the whole tapestry.

characters.title: The Bloodhowl

ability.name: Blood Frenzy
ability.shortEffect: Pay 5 HP to double Strike dice contribution, or triple it if below one-third HP when activated.

characters.visualSignature: Boar tusks and shoulders, wolf-like predatory posture, ragged bat membranes, heavy great-axe.
characters.cardCopy: The closer he comes to death, the harder he hits.

characters.title: The Thornwarden

ability.name: Rootbind
ability.shortEffect: Cancel the current enemy action.

characters.visualSignature: Mantis forearm shapes, deer-like crown and legs, overlapping pangolin scales, long thorned glaive.
characters.cardCopy: An ancient sentinel that arrests violence mid-stride.

characters.title: The Gear-Saint

ability.name: Clockwork Overwind
ability.shortEffect: After rolling, choose one die and add 3 to its contribution after the natural-face rule.

characters.visualSignature: Frog-like compact stance, armadillo armour segments, beetle shell plates, hammer with clockwork relics.
characters.cardCopy: He cannot add another die to fate, but he can overdrive one.

characters.title: The Dirgesinger

ability.name: Requiem Reversal
ability.shortEffect: If the enemy attacks, convert its damage components into healing.

characters.visualSignature: Fox-like face and stance, peacock display feathers, cicada wing textures, resonant lyre weapon.
characters.cardCopy: A death-song that turns incoming harm into reprieve.

characters.title: The Hollow Star

ability.name: Perfected Ruin
ability.shortEffect: Pay 6 HP and set every combat die to its own maximum face; the d20 natural 20 contributes 25.

characters.visualSignature: Hare-like long ears, abyssal eel body lines, anglerfish lure, scythe edged with void-like negative space.
characters.cardCopy: He trades his own life for a moment of impossible certainty.

characters.title: The Ironhide

ability.name: Quillguard
ability.shortEffect: Gain 6 Guard; if the current attack damages Borik, return 3 damage.

characters.visualSignature: Low, dense musk-ox frame, wolverine claws and jaw, porcupine quills forming a defensive mantle.
characters.cardCopy: A living barricade bristling with consequences.

characters.title: The Red Talon

ability.name: Execution Mark
ability.shortEffect: Gain 4 Strike; if the enemy survives the normal Strike at 15 HP or less, deal an additional 6 damage.

characters.visualSignature: Tall secretary-bird legs and crest, shoebill-like heavy beak, caracal ear tufts, long executioner's glaive.
characters.cardCopy: He does not chase the wounded; he ends them.

characters.title: The Miremaw

ability.name: Armor Rend
ability.shortEffect: Deal 5 direct damage that bypasses Guard and reduce enemy Guard by 2 for its next defensive intent.

characters.visualSignature: Long gharial snout, monitor-lizard musculature, horned-lizard ridges, broad serrated cleaver.
characters.cardCopy: A swamp-born breaker that tears through the enemy's defenses.

characters.title: The Burrow King

ability.name: Earthbound Fortress
ability.shortEffect: Gain 10 Guard, plus 3 Guard if at least three dice are assigned to Guard.

characters.visualSignature: Aardvark muzzle and digging claws, echidna spines, tapir-like mass, broad earthbreaker hammer.
characters.cardCopy: The deeper he roots himself, the harder he is to move.

characters.title: The Drowned King

ability.name: Undertow
ability.shortEffect: Gain 4 Strike and reduce the next enemy attack by 4, to a minimum of 0.

characters.visualSignature: Albatross wingspan and weathered plumage, frigatebird throat silhouette, cormorant-dark finish, long tide-splitter spear.
characters.cardCopy: He brings the weight of a black sea into every exchange.

characters.title: The Red Furnace

ability.name: Caustic Sheath
ability.shortEffect: Reduce enemy Guard by 4 for its next defensive intent; if the next intent is not defensive, gain 4 Strike this turn without revealing that future intent.

characters.visualSignature: Velvet-worm texture and limbs, segmented centipede body accents, trap-jaw ant mandibles, twin caustic blades.
characters.cardCopy: Her venom either eats through a wall or sharpens the next strike.

characters.title: The Black Strider

ability.name: Breakneck Charge
ability.shortEffect: Gain 8 Strike; if the enemy survives the Strike, gain 4 Guard for its action.

characters.visualSignature: Cassowary casque and powerful legs, emu-like feather mass, rhea proportions, long rupture lance.
characters.cardCopy: A charging terror who turns momentum into a second line of defense.

characters.title: The Gloamstalker

ability.name: Shadowstep
ability.shortEffect: Negate current attack damage; gain 4 Strike if at least three dice are assigned to Strike. Attached status effects remain.

characters.visualSignature: Genet-like long body and spotted coat, civet facial mask, binturong tail, paired shadow hook-blades.
characters.cardCopy: She slips past the blow, but not always its lingering curse.

characters.title: The Pale Deep

ability.name: Abyssal Regrowth
ability.shortEffect: Heal 7 HP, or 10 HP if below half maximum HP when activated; healing cannot exceed maximum HP.

characters.visualSignature: Pale amphibian skin, salamander folds, caecilian ringed body details, olm-like translucent features, ossuary staff.
characters.cardCopy: From the lightless deep, damaged flesh remembers how to live.

characters.title: The Nightglider

ability.name: Slipstream
ability.shortEffect: Reroll up to two selected dice for free; each die can be rerolled at most once, and each new result must be kept.

characters.visualSignature: Gliding membranes shaped by flying-squirrel and colugo traits, sugar-glider facial markings, paired crescent daggers.
characters.cardCopy: A fleeting silhouette that gets one more chance to shape the roll.
